system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy at War

Designed to take out tanks and other Vehicles, Limpet Mines are flat and about the size of a dinner plate. One side of the Mine has a handle for easy gripping, and the other side is covered with microbeads of adhesive that break on hard contact with a flat surface (Such as the side of a tank), ensuring solid adhesion. The shaped charge of the Limpet Mine causes negligible damage beyond it's 1-square Burst radius, and ignores the DR of the object or Vehicle it is attached to.

Activating a Limpet Mine is a Standard Action. The detonation is delayed for one round, providing opportunity to move away before the Limpet Mine explodes. Vehicles and Droids that are Large or larger offer sufficient surface area for attaching a Limpet Mine, but the Mines cannot be used on characters or smaller Droids.
